keys.beat: The fleet enters a narrow harbor ringed by cliffs; Odysseus alone moors outside.
keys.text: We found a fine harbour, with high rocks all round it, and a narrow mouth at the entrance. The captains took all their ships inside... but I kept my own ship outside, and moored it to a rock at the very end of the point.

keys.beat: Three scouts meet a giant girl who directs them to her parents' house.
keys.text: They found his wife, and she was as big as a mountain; they were horrified at her.

keys.beat: The queen summons Antiphates, who seizes and eats one scout.
keys.text: Antiphates... raised a cry through the town, which brought thousands of sturdy Laestrygonians running from every quarter: ogres, not men.

keys.beat: Laestrygonians mass on the cliffs, spear crews like fish, and crush the trapped ships with boulders.
keys.text: They threw vast rocks at us from the cliffs as though they had been mere stones, and I heard the horrid sound of the ships crunching up against one another, and the death cries of my men.

keys.beat: Odysseus cuts his cable and escapes with only his own ship.
keys.text: I drew my sword, and cut the cable of my own ship, telling my men to row with all their might if they too would not fare like the rest... we fell to our oars with a will, and got out into the open sea.
